shadows.name: photo-hover
shadows.purpose: Mouse inspection of a field photograph.

motion.name: photo-world
motion.value: five bodies below 700px; seven at larger widths; fixed 1/120s substeps; bounded velocity
motion.purpose: Continuous authored magnetic motion without an external library; fewer bodies for small galleries.

motion.name: photo-separation
motion.purpose: Strong photo-to-photo separation with weaker text repulsion and temporary muted, translucent blur.

motion.name: scroll-impulse
motion.value: input capped at ±180px; accumulated boost capped at ±52; decays over active time
motion.purpose: Native scrolling changes velocity independently of lifetime time.

motion.name: retirement-eligibility
motion.value: normally ≥9s visible for clear photos; continuous gray >3.2s permits earlier exit
motion.purpose: Visibility budget can defer departure; maintain three visible residents on phones and four on desktop when enough gallery exists.

motion.name: replacement-gate
motion.value: fully offscreen old photo + decoded next asset
motion.purpose: Rebind only outside the viewport, then re-enter; no visible source flashes.

motion.name: target-hold
motion.value: hover .8s; pointer-down 1.2s; visible keyboard focus until blur
motion.purpose: Only the targeted photo holds; all other field photos continue.

motion.name: viewer-flip
motion.purpose: Clicked source rectangle enlarges to the center; interrupted enlargement reverses from its current frame.

motion.name: edge-blend
motion.value: 14px navigation blur; 9px screen-edge blur; fading masks
motion.purpose: Soft navigation and viewport edges without a hard cutoff.

motion.name: motion-gates
motion.value: open viewer pauses field; hidden document cancels loop and resets timestamp; reduced motion keeps static scroll-responsive shading
motion.purpose: Reduced motion disables automatic rotation and CSS motion, with a 100ms opacity-only viewer path.

components.name: Contact navigation
components.description: Fading blurred navigation with About at left and contact links at right; specimen fits its container.

components.name: Browse photos
components.description: Underlined entry to the full gallery; no separate filled primary button.

components.name: Viewer previous control
components.description: Circular 44px control; next and close use the same treatment.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="Previous photo"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m14 5-7 7 7 7"/></svg></button>

components.name: Photo frame
components.description: Frame-only specimen; production uses original user images at their saved aspect ratio.

components.name: Viewer caption
components.description: Saved caption, optional date, and live position count; text is illustrative.

narrative.northStar: A field of personal photographs around steady text
narrative.overview:
The sage ground, evergreen ink, large two-line Georgia name, and minimal contact navigation are the established identity. William's photographs supply color and depth; supporting interface elements stay quiet. The approved photo field now carries this identity on the production homepage, continuing around the bio as the visitor scrolls.

This records the user's approved adoption of the existing-world extension as the durable homepage system. The implementation is code-led and follows the locked composition; no new visual selection workflow is required. Route-specific composition and approval live in `.impeccable/surfaces/homepage.md`; product facts remain in `PRODUCT.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Natural photographic proportions and level edges.
A calm, readable center surrounded by distributed imagery.
Restrained green interface colors, Georgia expression, and system sans utility text.
Quiet motion with accessible static and keyboard paths.

rules.name: Original Color
rules.body: Keep photographs in their own colors; interface palette changes must not recolor the images.

rules.name: Steady Center
rules.body: Photographs recede around measured reading zones; text does not move to accommodate them.

dos: **Do** preserve the sage and evergreen identity, Georgia name, original photo colors, and contact logos.
**Do** preserve natural photo proportions, five phone / seven desktop active bodies, and the visible-resident budget.
**Do** maintain visible focus, keyboard browsing, reduced motion, hidden-document suspension, and optional dates.
**Do** derive the local saved preview from production source and keep gallery edge cases working.
donts: **Don't** add a navigation divider or a visible pause-photos control.
**Don't** add embedded metadata to the user's photographs; keep any provenance outside the image files.
**Don't** substitute a new visual direction for the approved photo field or make text drift with the photographs.
**Don't** duplicate gallery data, replace visible photographs, or pile additional photos onto occupied field bodies.
